title: Bunny wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bunny body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#F5E6D0'/>
  <!-- Bunny belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#FFF8EE'/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='6' ry='16' fill='#F5E6D0'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='3' ry='12' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='6' ry='16' fill='#F5E6D0'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='3' ry='12' fill='#FFB6C1'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='17' fill='#F5E6D0'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='56' r='4' fill='#FFD1DC'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='56' r='4' fill='#FFD1DC'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='49' r='3' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='49' r='3' fill='#2B1B4A'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FF8FAB'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M47 58 Q50 61 53 58' stroke='#C97B63' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,18 38,38 62,38' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='50,22 42,34 58,34' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <polygon points='50,27 45,33 55,33' fill='#6BCBFF'/>
  <!-- Hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='3.5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='37' y='36' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='74' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#F5E6D0' transform='rotate(-20 29 74)'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='74' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#F5E6D0' transform='rotate(20 71 74)'/>
  <!-- Left foot -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='94' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#F5E6D0'/>
  <!-- Right foot -->
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='94' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#F5E6D0'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='88' r='5' fill='#FFF8EE'/>
</svg>
